policies.title: Albanian standard ordinary biometric passports: French West Indies visa-free visit
policies.summary: Both current French West Indies Annex II rule families waive Albanian biometric passports, and Albania's current ordinary-passport population is entirely biometric.
conditions: FW is the intersection of Guadeloupe, Martinique, Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy. Each current Annex II waives Albanian biometric passport holders for a short visitor stay.

Albania's ordinary passport is statutorily biometric. Any non-biometric ordinary document pre-dates the 2010 biometric regime and cannot survive its five- or ten-year statutory term on 25 August 2026; later emergency or accelerated ordinary issuance is biometric.
The uniform short-stay cap is 90 days in any 180-day period. Work, residence, transit, Schengen travel, special travel documents, passport validity and final admission are outside this policy.

policies.title: Montenegrin standard ordinary biometric passports: French West Indies visa-free visit
policies.summary: Both current French West Indies Annex II rule families waive Montenegrin biometric passports, and all current standard ordinary Montenegrin passports are electronic biometric passports.
conditions: FW is the intersection of Guadeloupe, Martinique, Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy. Each current Annex II waives Montenegrin biometric passport holders for a short visitor stay.

The governing passport law makes the ordinary passport an electronic document with a facial-photo and two-fingerprint chip. The ten-year, under-four child two-year and temporarily-unobtainable-fingerprint one-year variants remain that statutory passport; return certificates and special documents are excluded. Former-FRY-form passports have been invalid since 31 December 2009.
The uniform short-stay cap is 90 days in any 180-day period. Work, residence, transit, Schengen travel, special travel documents, passport validity and final admission are outside this policy.

policies.title: North Macedonian standard ordinary biometric passports: French West Indies visa-free visit
policies.summary: Both current French West Indies Annex II rule families waive North Macedonian biometric passports, and no currently valid standard ordinary North Macedonian passport remains non-biometric.
conditions: FW is the intersection of Guadeloupe, Martinique, Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy. Each current Annex II waives North Macedonian biometric passport holders for a short visitor stay.

North Macedonian issuer material specifies the ordinary passport's biometric enrolment and age-based 10/5/2-year terms. The current official civil-document record says every passport has been biometric since April 2012, so any non-biometric ordinary passport expired no later than April 2022; earlier Republic-of-Macedonia passports are invalid for international travel from 13 February 2024.

The uniform short-stay cap is 90 days in any 180-day period. Work, residence, transit, Schengen travel, emergency, temporary, group, diplomatic, service, refugee, alien and other special-document routes, passport validity and final admission are outside this policy.
